entities.name: Luis Alberto Rodríguez López-Calleja
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luis Alberto Rodríguez López-Calleja was a Cuban military general, businessman and politician. He was the head of Cuba's state-run enterprise GAESA and has been described as one of Cuba's most powerful people. A key member of Cuba's Central Committee of the Communist Party, he was once married to Raúl Castro's daughter Deborah. He died on 1 July 2022, of a heart attack.
